children: Kuwait’s Boubyan Bank, rated A2 by Moody’s, and A by S&P and Fitch, has raised 90 million dinars ($292 million) from a KWD-denominated AT1 sukuk, with a fixed rate coupon of 5.50%.
The perpetual issuance has a rating of BBB-, with Boubyan Tier 1 Sukuk II Limited listed as the issuer and the Kuwait-listed bank named obliger.
Kamco Investment Company was the mandated lead manager, with Boubyan Capital Investment Company named co-manager of the Mudaraba sukuk.
In August, the bank received regulatory approvals for the issuance of up to KWD 100 million ($324 million) as a perpetual AT1 sukuk.
(Writing by Bindu Rai, editing by Brinda Darasha)

title: Kuwait’s Boubyan Bank raises KWD90mln from perpetual 5-year AT1
